priorityList: Use Trinkets and Potions during Metamorphosis for maximum burst damage.
Apply Soul Immolation if it is not active, Metamorphosis is down, and multiple enemies are present.
Cast Metamorphosis while Eradicate is active to maximize power.
Cast Void Ray if the Eradicate buff is not currently active on the player.
Cast Voidblade or The Hunt if you are at maximum Metamorphosis stacks (requires Devourer's Bite and Voidsurge).
Use the Reaps sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if 4 or more souls are consumed and Metamorphosis is active.
Use the Reaps sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if Voidfall is proc'd or Eradicate is already active in AoE.
Cast Pierce the Veil if Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Cast Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and you are at or near maximum soul capacity.
Cast Collapsing Star if Predator's Wake is not ready and Voidblade is on cooldown.
Use Vengeful Retreat when Voidstep is active to trigger mobility-based buffs.
Cast Hungering Slash as your primary AoE builder and soul generator.
Cast Reaper's Toll for significant AoE damage and soul generation.
Use Devour and Consume as final fillers when no other high-priority abilities are available.
